continue.title: Keep working in chat.
paragraphs: Open a topic for your next task. Choose which saved documents to attach, then discuss the project with AI Chat.

terms.title: Access, tokens and your materials
paragraphs: Registration shows the current free token allowance. Paid AI work uses the token balance.

items.title: Token cost
items.text: 0.13 roubles per internal token. One token is charged when input is sent; a successful request settles at actual provider cost, rounded up to a whole internal token, with a minimum of one token.

items.title: Top-ups
items.text: 100, 300, 500, 1,000 or 3,000 roubles, at the same rate without package discounts. Tokens do not expire. Cash refunds for purchases are decided case by case.

items.title: Balance limit
items.text: The balance can go below zero. At −2,000 internal tokens or lower, new paid AI requests are restricted. Top up above the threshold to return to your saved task.

items.title: Failed or cancelled AI requests
items.text: All token deductions are restored, including the initial token and any settlement. The net charge is zero; the service pays the provider expense.

items.title: Support
items.text: Initial support requests are processed within 24 hours, without continuous live coverage or a promised resolution time.

items.title: Materials
items.text: Review how your materials are processed and stored before uploading. Account deletion removes active data; infrastructure backups may retain copies for up to six months.
